result.title: STAGE: Structured Test-Time Adaptation with Global Entropic Soft-coupling for Cross-Subject Brain-to-Image Retrieval
result.comment: 38 pages, including the main paper and appendix
result.summary: Cross-subject brain-to-image retrieval aims to identify viewed images from unseen subjects' brain signals. However, inter-subject variability hinders alignment of brain-image representations, while independent query ranking tends to concentrate predictions on a few candidates, making accurate retrieval difficult without target labels. We propose STAGE (Structured Test-Time Adaptation with Global Entropic Soft-coupling), a structured test-time adaptation framework for recovering cross-subject alignment from uncertain brain-image correspondences. Moment calibration reduces statistical discrepancies between features, while coupling-weighted initialization establishes initial alignment. Coupling-guided adaptation further refines residual feature mismatches, and soft-coupling ranking coordinates candidate competition across queries to prevent overly concentrated matching assignments. Using only unlabeled target batches, STAGE maintains consistent matching from feature calibration to image retrieval while keeping both encoders frozen. Experiments on three public datasets validate STAGE's retrieval performance. On THINGS-EEG2, STAGE achieves 68.25% Top-1 and 90.47% Top-5, improving Top-1 by 18.52 percentage points over SCORE recovery and CSLS on identical frozen NICE features. Calibrated on 200 queries and a 200-image gallery covering their identities, STAGE retains 42.05% Top-1 when ranking 1,854 images with the transform frozen.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 STAGE，一个面向跨被试脑信号到图像检索的无标签测试时适配框架：用矩校准减小特征统计差异、耦合加权初始化建立对齐，再以耦合引导适配细化残差，并用软耦合排序协调多个 query 间的候选竞争，编码器全程冻结。
AI.relevance_reason: 其全局熵软耦合排序在 query 之间协调候选分配、抑制预测过度集中，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态与证据分配的多样性保持及测试时无标签校准提供可核查线索，但任务本身不涉及视觉推理链或 latent 推理。
